meta.about: Story guidance (docs/unreal/PLAY.md, guide lane): which step is next, the hint line after a while without progress, the objective marker and the ground path drawn from the player to the next step. Presentation only: nothing here changes what the simulation computes (no collision, no timing, no rule). Read by AMIGuide (World/MIGuide.cpp) and the HUD.
meta.units: web units: metres, seconds; colours linear RGB; intensity in nits (the scene's physical units: a sunlit street is about 3,000 to 10,000)

path.note: repath: seconds between path searches (A* on the nav grid the Goons use, on a private copy); minRepath: the soonest a new search follows a stray; stray: metres off the drawn path that ask for a new search at once; keep: a new route replaces the drawn one only when it is shorter than keep x what is left of it (no flip between two routes of equal length); spacing: metres between chevrons, laid from the goal backwards so they stay put while the player walks; ahead / reach: the first and last metres of the path drawn, measured from the player; stopShort: metres before the goal where the chevrons stop; fadeIn: metres over which the chevrons grow at both ends; elevated: feet this far above the ground mean an upper floor (the path then goes down the nearest stair in waysDown first); stepUp: the highest kerb the chevrons climb; maxChevrons: the pool (a multiple of look.phases)

underlay.note: A dark strip under each lit arm (the engine plane's own lit material, in every package: its Color parameter), width x the arm's width, longer metres longer, drop metres under it: the chevron reads as a lit line on black on sunlit concrete and asphalt (review: amber on the bare ground read as faded line paint and vanished in full sun). An empty material draws none

look.note: Colour: cyan, unlike any road paint, crosswalk or brick on the block (amber read as faded yellow line paint). Chevrons of two thin flat strips on the engine plane, in the unlit additive tracer material (no new asset: it is in every package), depth tested, no collision, no shadow. shade: intensity under a roof, the El or inside the chop shop (a box above the chevron), where the eye is adapted darker; combat: intensity while any enemy is engaging (faded over combatFade seconds); phases and chase: a light runs toward the goal through phases groups at chase cycles a second, between low and 1 of the intensity

marker.note: The next step's marker: full strength beyond fadeFar metres, gone at fadeNear (the grab prompt takes over); off the screen an arrow on its edge, edge pixels in (at 1080 lines)

hints.note: The hint line shows after `after` seconds of play without progress (combat does not count) and stays until the player is `progress` metres closer along the path than ever before on this step

reel1.hint: Reel 1's out on the avenue, under the El. Head east.

reel2.hint: Reel 2's inside V&R Auto Body, north side. The bay door's open.

reel3.hint: Reel 3's in the cage at the north-east end. The gate's off the avenue.

extraction.hint: The IPX truck's idling at the south end of the lot. Get to its back doors.

block.waysDown_note: The upper floors a player can reach on foot and the stair down from each (the station's stair is closed: its steps are 0.75 m, over the 0.42 m a body climbs)

reel4.hint: Reel 4's on a table outside the market. South side of Canal.

reel5.hint: Back of the market. The cold room, by the west wall.

reel6.hint: The dub room's at the south end of Mott St. Its shutter's the only one up.

extraction.hint: The truck's at the east end of Canal. Cut through the arcade off the square.

reel7.hint: The tanks are one roof down from the top. Steel stair on the east side of the high roof.

reel8.hint: The gantry's behind the big screen, on the low roof. Stairs at the south edge of the tank roof.

reel9.hint: The booth's under the stand, north end of the square. Scaffold off the gantry, or the service stair inside.

extraction.hint: The truck's on Forty-Sixth, east of the square. Down Broadway, past the bus.
